stories.headline: Starship hit orbit. The booster blew up.
stories.body: SpaceX tried to <mark>catch both stages</mark> in one flight. The booster was diverted, <mark>fell into the Gulf and exploded</mark>. The ship still reached orbit and <mark>released 26 Starlink satellites</mark>. Next: an <mark>orbit-to-pad catch</mark> attempt, a first, planned for Saturday.

stories.headline: Perseverance found organic carbon on Mars.
stories.body: The rover detected <mark>complex organic carbon</mark> just microns under the surface of ancient rocks in <mark>Jezero Crater</mark>, the shallowest find yet. It <mark>doesn't prove life</mark>, since non-living chemistry can make it too. Only <mark>samples brought to Earth</mark> could tell more.

stories.headline: AMD stock dropped 8.75% in one day.
stories.body: AMD closed Friday at <mark>$534.06</mark> after chip stocks reversed their early gains, with <mark>profit-taking</mark> and Nvidia uncertainty after its CEO's exit. AMD was up as much as <mark>30% earlier this week</mark> and still ended the week up. <mark>Nvidia reports next week.</mark>

stories.headline: A nationwide US flight stop. AI is being checked.
stories.body: A <mark>telecom failure</mark> hit air traffic control centers Friday and triggered a <mark>nationwide ground stop</mark>. Officials are examining whether the FAA's new <mark>AI airspace tool, SMART</mark>, played a part. They stress it's <mark>not established</mark> and <mark>no public threat</mark> exists.
